description: This file is a Java unit test class for the 'ThingCreated' class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains tests that verify immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and event parsing functionality for 'ThingCreated' objects.

classes.name: ThingCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for 'ThingCreated', containing test methods to verify its behavior.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that 'ThingCreated' instances are immutable and that 'Thing' objects used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the hashCode and equals implementations of 'ThingCreated' using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThing
methods.description: Ensures that creating a 'ThingCreated' instance with a null 'Thing' results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the JSON representation of a 'ThingCreated' instance matches the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Verifies that a 'ThingCreated' object can be correctly created from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: retrieveEventName
methods.description: Validates that the event name extracted from the JSON matches 'ThingCreated.NAME'.

methods.name: parseThingCreatedEvent
methods.description: Tests parsing a JSON object into a 'ThingCreated' event using 'GlobalEventRegistry'.
